entities.summary: Katsuhiko Nakajima  is a Japanese professional wrestler. He is primarily working for Gleat, where he is the former one-times Lidet UWF World Champion. He is a former Triple Crown Heavyweight Champion in All Japan Pro Wrestling and a two-time GHC Heavyweight Champion in Pro Wrestling Noah.
